notes:
v1.0.44 - potato-tier FPS cap removed (real-hardware diagnosis).

A live test showed every scenario pinned at 58-60 FPS (walking, breaking,
ocean, new chunks) with drops only on heavy scenes (TNT, 800+ arrows).
The launcher log told the real story: tier=potato, maxFps=60 in
options.txt, -Dreimagined.maxfps=60 passed to the game, VSync on.

Fix: the potato tier no longer forces maxFps:60 - ALL tiers now default
to 260 (vanilla "Unlimited"), consistent with the no-forced-cap
philosophy. Potato keeps its conservative settings (RD 8-10, LOD 48,
reduced FX) for stability; only the FPS ceiling is lifted.

Tip: on a 60 Hz panel, enable Settings -> "Force VSync off" so VSync
cannot pin the game to 60 Hz.
